sentences.en: The separatists have their own terminology to describe the world.
sentences.zh: 分离主义者有自己的专门用语来描述世界。

sentences.en: Sami doesn't understand the terminology that Layla is using.
sentences.zh: 萨米不明白莱拉使用的术语。

sentences.en: This is no time to quibble over terminology.
sentences.zh: 现在不是在术语上纠缠不清的时候。

senses.zh: 专门用语；术语；术语学术语的正确使用, 术语用法形容词:terminological
